text: No man is distrait with the man he fears, or the woman he loves; which is a proof that every man can get the better of that DISTRACTION, when he thinks it worth his while to do so; and, take my word for it, it is always worth his while.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter LXXXII, to his son, London, September 22, Old Style 1749
